text: Hurad Kohli's greatest chase was in the 82 not out at the MCG. It was 183 in Merpol.
Now I know what you are thinking, nothing beats that night against Pakistan in Melbourne, right? But hear me out.
March 2012, Asia Cup Mirpur, India vs Pakistan. Pakistan smashed 3 29 200s from Hoppies and Naseel Jamshed. Back then chasing 3 30 against Pakistan felt almost impossible.
and it got worse, Gambi was gone for a duck, India was 0 for 1 and involved a 23 year old Virat Kohli
He did not panic, he batted alongside Sachin Tendulkar in one of Sachin's last story eyes.
and then built a massive partnership with Ruchir Mahal. Umar Ghul saeed Ajmal Shahid Afrid he took all of them on 22-4s and the faster the asking rate went up the calmer he caught.
183 of 148 balls. His highest ever ODI score India chased it down with 13 balls to a speed.
For me the mcd was pure magic but Mirpur was there, the chaismaster was born.
So 183 in Mirpur or 80 to not out at the MCT which one gets your vote comment below and follow for more
